verdict.rationale: Antigravity ships an official Agent SDK (Python) exposing the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power the product, letting developers build custom agentic workflows programmatically, plus support for MCP servers and custom callables layered on it (docs-13, docs-14, docs-15). However, there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usage and no public API reference/OpenAPI spec was found (probe-3 shows 404s for API specs). Missing for 10: independent developer usage reports of the SDK, a full API reference/spec, and versioning/release cadence details.
